query: select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'table',c.relname,'column',a.attname,'generated',a.attgenerated,'identity',a.attidentity,'expression',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid))) as generated_columns from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid=a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace left join pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=c.oid and d.adnum=a.attnum where n.nspname in ('public','private') and (a.attgenerated<>'' or a.attidentity<>'');
